name: sixtyfold-components
description: High-performance TypeScript components for AI, observability, industrial IoT, and financial markets.

scripts.build:packages: pnpm run check:mcp-guidance && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm run check:mcp-catalog
scripts.check:examples: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:examples && node scripts/check-framework-examples.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:base && pnpm run lint:type-aware
scripts.lint:type-aware: oxlint --type-aware -A all -D typescript/no-floating-promises -D typescript/no-misused-promises -D typescript/await-thenable -D typescript/no-for-in-array -D typescript/restrict-plus-operands packages/*/src
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-test-typecheck-coverage.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.react.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.solid.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && node scripts/benchmark-grid-suite.mjs typecheck && pnpm --parallel --filter @sixtyfold/react --filter @sixtyfold/vue --filter @sixtyfold/angular --filter @sixtyfold/svelte --filter @sixtyfold/solid run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run test:e2e:built
scripts.test:ssr:runtimes: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run test:ssr:node && pnpm run test:ssr:bun && pnpm run test:ssr:deno
scripts.themes:generate: pnpm --filter @sixtyfold/themes exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/generate-theme-subpaths.mjs write && pnpm --filter @sixtyfold/themes exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
